<script>
const drawBarChart = (canvasEl, labels, values, { rotateLabels = false, barColor = null } = {}) => {
	const isDark = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
	const primary = isDark ? "#fac800" : "#990000";
	const textColor = isDark ? "#c9c9c9" : "#444444";
	const gridColor = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.08)";
	const axisColor = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)";
	const bar = barColor || primary;

	const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
	const W = Math.max(canvasEl.parentElement?.clientWidth || 640, 320);
	const padB = rotateLabels ? 72 : 48;
	const H = 300;
	const padL = 48, padR = 16, padT = 30;
	const cW = W - padL - padR;
	const cH = H - padT - padB;

	canvasEl.width = W * dpr;
	canvasEl.height = H * dpr;
	canvasEl.style.width = W + "px";
	canvasEl.style.height = H + "px";

	const ctx = canvasEl.getContext("2d");
	ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

	const maxVal = Math.max(...values, 1);
	const niceMax = Math.ceil(maxVal / 5) * 5 || 5;
	const nTicks = 5;

	for (let t = 0; t <= nTicks; t++) {
		const v = (t / nTicks) * niceMax;
		const y = padT + cH - (v / niceMax) * cH;
		ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
		ctx.lineWidth = 1;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(padL, y);
		ctx.lineTo(padL + cW, y);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
		ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
		ctx.textAlign = "right";
		ctx.fillText(Math.round(v), padL - 6, y + 4);
	}

	const n = labels.length;
	const slot = cW / n;
	const barW = Math.max(slot * 0.65, 4);
	const barOffset = (slot - barW) / 2;

	labels.forEach((lbl, i) => {
		const val = values[i];
		const bH = Math.max((val / niceMax) * cH, 0);
		const x = padL + slot * i + barOffset;
		const y = padT + cH - bH;

		ctx.fillStyle = bar;
		ctx.fillRect(x, y, barW, bH);

		if (val > 0) {
			ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
			ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(val, x + barW / 2, Math.max(y - 5, padT + 12));
		}

		ctx.save();
		ctx.translate(x + barW / 2, padT + cH + 10);
		if (rotateLabels) {
			ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 4);
			ctx.textAlign = "right";
		} else {
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
		}
		ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
		ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
		ctx.fillText(lbl, 0, 0);
		ctx.restore();
	});

	ctx.strokeStyle = axisColor;
	ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.moveTo(padL, padT);
	ctx.lineTo(padL, padT + cH);
	ctx.lineTo(padL + cW, padT + cH);
	ctx.stroke();
};

const renderPubChart = (rows) => {
	const canvas = document.getElementById("pub-chart");
	const caption = document.getElementById("pub-chart-caption");
	if (!canvas) return;

	const yearCounts = {};
	rows.forEach(({ year }) => {
		if (year) yearCounts[year] = (yearCounts[year] || 0) + 1;
	});

	const years = Object.keys(yearCounts).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
	const counts = years.map((y) => yearCounts[y]);

	drawBarChart(canvas, years, counts, { rotateLabels: years.length > 10 });

	if (caption) {
		caption.textContent = `Publications per year: ${years.map((y) => `${y} (${yearCounts[y]})`).join(", ")}.`;
	}
};

const cleanField = (value) => {
	if (!value) return "";
	const asText = String(value)
		.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")
		.replace(/[{}]/g, "")
		.replace(/\\[a-zA-Z]+\s*/g, "")
		.replace(/\s+/g, " ")
		.trim();

	const decode = document.createElement("textarea");
	decode.innerHTML = asText;
	return decode.value;
};

const parseAuthors = (rawAuthors) => {
	if (!rawAuthors) return "";
	return cleanField(rawAuthors)
		.split(/\s+and\s+/i)
		.map((name) => name.trim())
		.filter(Boolean)
		.join(", ");
};

const entryLink = (fields) => {
	const doi = cleanField(fields.doi || fields.DOI);
	const url = cleanField(fields.url || fields.URL);
	if (doi) return `https://doi.org/${doi}`;
	return url;
};

const parseBibEntries = (text) => {
	const entries = [];
	const normalized = String(text || "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
	let index = 0;
	const skipWhitespace = () => { while (index < normalized.length && /\s/.test(normalized[index])) index += 1; };
	const readUntil = (terminator) => { const start = index; while (index < normalized.length && normalized[index] !== terminator) index += 1; return normalized.slice(start, index); };
	const readBalancedBlock = (openChar, closeChar) => { let depth = 1; const start = index; while (index < normalized.length) { const char = normalized[index]; if (char === openChar) depth += 1; if (char === closeChar) depth -= 1; index += 1; if (depth === 0) return normalized.slice(start, index - 1); } return ""; };
	const parseFields = (body) => {
		const fields = {}; let i = 0;
		const skipFieldWhitespace = () => { while (i < body.length && /\s/.test(body[i])) i += 1; };
		const readFieldValue = () => {
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] === "{") { i += 1; let depth = 1; const start = i; while (i < body.length) { const char = body[i]; if (char === "{") depth += 1; if (char === "}") depth -= 1; i += 1; if (depth === 0) return body.slice(start, i - 1); } return ""; }
			if (body[i] === '"') { i += 1; const start = i; while (i < body.length) { if (body[i] === '"' && body[i - 1] !== "\\") break; i += 1; } const value = body.slice(start, i); i += 1; return value; }
			const start = i; while (i < body.length && body[i] !== ",") i += 1; return body.slice(start, i).trim();
		};
		while (i < body.length) {
			skipFieldWhitespace(); if (i >= body.length) break;
			const keyStart = i; while (i < body.length && /[\w\-]/.test(body[i])) i += 1;
			const key = body.slice(keyStart, i).trim(); skipFieldWhitespace(); if (body[i] !== "=") break;
			i += 1; const value = readFieldValue(); if (key) fields[key] = value; skipFieldWhitespace(); if (body[i] === ",") i += 1;
		}
		return fields;
	};
	while (index < normalized.length) {
		const at = normalized.indexOf("@", index); if (at === -1) break; index = at + 1; skipWhitespace();
		const typeStart = index; while (index < normalized.length && /[A-Za-z]/.test(normalized[index])) index += 1;
		const entryType = normalized.slice(typeStart, index).toLowerCase(); skipWhitespace(); if (normalized[index] !== "{") continue; index += 1;
		const key = readUntil(",").trim(); if (normalized[index] === ",") index += 1;
		const body = readBalancedBlock("{", "}"); const entryTags = parseFields(body); entries.push({ entryType, citationKey: key, entryTags });
	}
	return entries;
};

const loadPublications = async () => {
	const status = document.getElementById("pub-load-status");
	const pubList = document.getElementById("pub-list");
	const filters = document.getElementById("pub-filters");
	let yearFilter = document.getElementById("pub-year-filter");
	let searchBox = document.getElementById("pub-search");
	const setStatus = (message) => {
		if (status) status.textContent = message;
	};

	if (!pubList) {
		setStatus("Unable to load publications: Publications list container is missing.");
		return;
	}

	if (filters && !yearFilter) {
		const yearGroup = document.createElement("div");
		const yearLabel = document.createElement("label");
		yearLabel.setAttribute("for", "pub-year-filter");
		yearLabel.textContent = "Year:";
		yearFilter = document.createElement("select");
		yearFilter.id = "pub-year-filter";
		yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter publications by year");
		const allYears = document.createElement("option");
		allYears.value = "";
		allYears.textContent = "All years";
		yearFilter.appendChild(allYears);
		yearGroup.appendChild(yearLabel);
		yearGroup.appendChild(yearFilter);
		filters.appendChild(yearGroup);
	}

	if (filters && !searchBox) {
		const searchGroup = document.createElement("div");
		const searchLabel = document.createElement("label");
		searchLabel.setAttribute("for", "pub-search");
		searchLabel.textContent = "Search:";
		searchBox = document.createElement("input");
		searchBox.type = "text";
		searchBox.id = "pub-search";
		searchBox.className = "pub-search-box";
		searchBox.placeholder = "Search titles, authors, venues...";
		searchBox.setAttribute("aria-label", "Search publications");
		searchGroup.appendChild(searchLabel);
		searchGroup.appendChild(searchBox);
		filters.appendChild(searchGroup);
	}

	try {
		// Try multiple potential paths for the bib file
		let bibText = null;
		const potentialPaths = [
			"works.bib",
			"../works.bib",
			"/ccg/works.bib"
		];

		for (const path of potentialPaths) {
			try {
				const response = await fetch(path);
				if (response.ok) {
					bibText = await response.text();
					console.log(`Successfully loaded from: ${path}`);
					break;
				}
			} catch (e) {
				// Try next path
			}
		}

		if (!bibText) {
			throw new Error("Could not load works.bib from any location");
		}

		const entries = parseBibEntries(bibText);
		
		if (entries.length === 0) {
			throw new Error("No publications found in works.bib");
		}

		const rows = entries.map((entry) => {
			const fields = entry.entryTags || {};
			const title = cleanField(fields.title || "");
			const authors = parseAuthors(fields.author || "");
			const year = cleanField(fields.year || "");
			const venue = cleanField(fields.journal || fields.booktitle || fields.publisher || "");
			const link = entryLink(fields);
			
			return { title, authors, year, venue, link, searchText: `${title} ${authors} ${venue}`.toLowerCase() };
		});

		rows.sort((a, b) => Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0));
		renderPubChart(rows);

		// Populate year filter
		[...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.year).filter(Boolean))]
			.sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a))
			.forEach((year) => {
				if (yearFilter) {
					const option = document.createElement("option");
					option.value = year;
					option.textContent = year;
					yearFilter.appendChild(option);
				}
			});

		const renderPubs = (filteredRows) => {
			pubList.innerHTML = filteredRows.map((row) => `
				<li class="pub-item">
					<span class="pub-year">${row.year}</span>
					<div class="pub-title">${row.title}</div>
					<div class="pub-authors"><strong>Authors:</strong> ${row.authors}</div>
					<div class="pub-venue"><strong>Venue:</strong> ${row.venue}</div>
					<div class="pub-link-container">
						${row.link ? `<a href="${row.link}" class="pub-link" title="View publication" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><span class="pub-link-icon">🔗</span> View Resource</a>` : ''}
					</div>
				</li>
			`).join("");
		};

		const applyFilters = () => {
			const yearValue = yearFilter?.value || "";
			const searchValue = searchBox?.value.toLowerCase() || "";

			const filtered = rows.filter((row) => {
				const yearMatch = !yearValue || row.year === yearValue;
				const searchMatch = !searchValue || row.searchText.includes(searchValue);
				return yearMatch && searchMatch;
			});

			renderPubs(filtered);
		};

		renderPubs(rows);
		if (yearFilter) yearFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		if (searchBox) searchBox.addEventListener("input", applyFilters);
		if (filters && (yearFilter || searchBox)) filters.style.display = "flex";
		setStatus(`Loaded ${rows.length} publications.`);
		console.log(`Successfully loaded ${rows.length} publications`);
	} catch (error) {
		setStatus(`Unable to load publications: ${error.message}`);
		console.error("Publications loading error:", error);
	}
};

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", loadPublications);
</script>
